noveltyJustification: First pass established the full causal chain from test-set construction and baseline mechanics to the exact verdict arithmetic, including the A-B = W-L identity the keep rule scores twice.

summary: The keep rests on the margin condition: A-B=29 exceeds the 25.6-row floor by 3.4 rows; a four-row swing flips the verdict.
Margin and sign test measure the same quantity: A-B is identically W-L, so the rule scores one difference twice at different strictness.
The 256 questions are a hash-ordered 20-per-track cap over 1727 usable packet descriptions; 85 percent of usable text is discarded and small tracks rest on as little as one row.
Questions are packet descriptions, not Gate 1 prompts; on the 14 gold-bearing paraphrase probes ripgrep beats Jev 8 to 2, so the accuracy ranking flips by input family.

Both baselines are structurally handicapped: lookup needs 80 percent single-phrase token coverage with the own-folder self-signal removed; ripgrep counts token presence in matched files and takes a plurality.
Abstention and instability are errors by construction: 57 abstained and 3 unstable rows out of the 159 wrong are explicit model refusals, not mis-picks.
